    import sys

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    idx = 0
    t = int(input[idx])
    idx += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input[idx])
        idx += 1
        a = list(map(int, input[idx:idx+n]))
        idx += n
        tag_count = defaultdict(list)
        for i, tag in enumerate(a):
            tag_count[tag].append(i)
        if any(len(indices) > (n + 1) // 2 for indices in tag_count.values()):
            results.append(-1)
            continue
        order = []
        for tag in sorted(tag_count.keys(), key=lambda x: len(tag_count[x]), reverse=True):
            order.extend(tag_count[tag])
        cost = 0
        for i in range(1, n):
            if a[order[i]] == a[order[i-1]]:
                results.append(-1)
                break
            if abs(order[i] - order[i-1]) > 1:
                cost += 1
        else:
            results.append(cost)
    print('\n'.join(map(str, results)))

main()
